'''Woorta Woorta''', formerly known as '''Woorta Cent''', was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Swokes Swokes/Legends|Swokes Swokes]] who lived in the city of [[Thousand Thousand]] on [[Makem Te/Legends|Makem Te]]. She was the daughter of the [[Sassa district]] [[Sassa district's caliph|caliph]].<ref name="GatORW" />
